name: Foodorder
description: 🍽️ Build a user-friendly online food ordering website with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, perfect for learning frontend development basics.

paragraphs: FoodOrder is a simple and user-friendly online food ordering website. It allows you to browse food items, view images, and interact with the website interface without any technical skills. This project focuses on the basics of frontend development and UI design. It's perfect for those just starting to learn about web development.
features: User-Friendly Interface: The layout is designed for ease of use.
Responsive Design: The site works well on various devices.
Interactive Elements: Experience basic interactivity with buttons and images.
Modern Styling: CSS ensures the site looks great and functions well.
Learning Tool: Ideal for those who want to learn web development fundamentals.
